role.en: Chair, Google DeepMind; Chief Scientist, Alphabet; CEO, Isomorphic Labs
role.zh: Google DeepMind 董事长；Alphabet 首席科学家；Isomorphic Labs CEO

why.en: 2024 Nobel laureate in Chemistry for AlphaFold. From AlphaGo to Gemini, the only person operating at the top of both scientific breakthrough and frontier model development — now stepping back from operations to focus on long-horizon safety and governance.
why.zh: 因 AlphaFold 获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。从 AlphaGo 到 Gemini，是唯一同时站在科学突破与前沿大模型两条战线顶端的人 —— 现已退出日常运营，转向长期安全与治理。

title.en: A new era of discovery: AI and the frontiers of science
title.zh: 发现的新纪元：AI 与科学前沿

note.en: On why he thinks we are at the start of a golden age of scientific discovery.
note.zh: 关于他为何认为我们正处在科学发现黄金时代的开端。

title.en: On AGI by 2030, curing diseases, and humanity's irreplaceable role
title.zh: 关于 2030 年前实现 AGI、治愈疾病，以及人类不可替代的角色

title.zh: 谈新职务与 Google 的 AI 平衡术

title.en: Honoured to receive the Albert Medal from @theRSAorg! Science & tech enable amazing opportunities, but the arts & humanities will be crucial in shaping what sor
title.zh: Honoured to receive the Albert Medal from @theRSAorg! Science & tech enable amazing opportunities, but the arts & humanities will be crucial in shaping what sor

note.en: Hassabis shared that he received the Royal Society of Arts' Albert Medal, using the moment to argue that the arts and humanities will be as crucial as science and technology in shaping the future.
note.zh: 哈萨比斯分享自己获得英国皇家艺术学会阿尔伯特奖章，并借此强调人文艺术将与科技同样重要，共同塑造未来。

title.en: Dario's essay points towards the right path forward. The details need working through, but the direction is correct for meeting this critical moment. This is al
title.zh: Dario's essay points towards the right path forward. The details need working through, but the direction is correct for meeting this critical moment. This is al

note.en: Hassabis endorsed the direction of Amodei's call for an AI slowdown, linking it to DeepMind's own recent safety proposal.
note.zh: 哈萨比斯认同阿莫迪呼吁AI放缓发展的方向，并将其与DeepMind近期提出的安全提案联系起来。

title.en: With AlphaFold we mapped the protein universe - now with AlphaGenome Atlas we’re charting the human genome. It can predict the impact of all 9 billion possible
title.zh: With AlphaFold we mapped the protein universe - now with AlphaGenome Atlas we’re charting the human genome. It can predict the impact of all 9 billion possible

note.en: Hassabis says AlphaGenome Atlas extends AlphaFold's mapping of the protein universe to charting the human genome, predicting the impact of all 9 billion possible single-letter DNA variants.
note.zh: Hassabis表示，继AlphaFold绘制蛋白质图谱之后，AlphaGenome Atlas进一步绘制人类基因组图谱，可预测全部90亿种可能的单碱基变异的影响。

note.zh: 哈萨比斯亲自宣布了Gemini 3.8 Flash及Flash Cyber模型升级,称其为DeepMind发布节奏中“不懈的进步”。

title.en: Gemini 3.7 Flash brings major upgrades for software engineering, web dev & knowledge work. And introductory price is half the original 3.6 Flash cost. Happy
title.zh: Gemini 3.7 Flash brings major upgrades for software engineering, web dev & knowledge work. And introductory price is half the original 3.6 Flash cost. Happy

note.zh: 推出SL2T手语转文字模型,与聋人社区合作开发,让用户可直接对着手机打手语进行输入。

note.en: Reflected on AlphaGo's famous move 37 and its lasting significance for math and science breakthroughs in verifiable domains, in conversation with a podcast host.
note.zh: 在一次对谈中回顾了AlphaGo著名的第37手棋,以及它对可验证领域中数学与科学突破的持久意义。

title.en: I’ve been working towards AGI my whole life, and as we enter this pivotal moment, I’m stepping into a new role as Chair of Google DeepMind & Chief Scientist of
title.zh: I’ve been working towards AGI my whole life, and as we enter this pivotal moment, I’m stepping into a new role as Chair of Google DeepMind & Chief Scientist of

note.en: Announced he is stepping into a new role as Chair of Google DeepMind and Chief Scientist of Alphabet, to focus more on AGI research.
note.zh: 宣布自己将转任Google DeepMind董事长兼Alphabet首席科学家的新职位,以更专注于AGI研究。

note.zh: 宣布Gemini Robotics 2模型套件,让机器人能够通过推理完成此前无法完成的动作,如打结。

title.en: A strong and secure open ecosystem is important for the world to benefit from AI. We’ve always supported and contributed heavily to open source and science from
title.zh: A strong and secure open ecosystem is important for the world to benefit from AI. We’ve always supported and contributed heavily to open source and science from

note.zh: 主张一个强大且安全的开放生态对AI造福社会至关重要,并列举了DeepMind从Jax、Transformer到AlphaFold、Gemma的一系列开源贡献。

title.zh: "Direction is correct": Google DeepMind co-founder Demis Hassabis backs Anthropic boss Dario Amodei's calls for AI slowdown

body.en: Hassabis publicly endorsed Dario Amodei's call to slow the pace of frontier AI development, a rare instance of a top lab leader backing a rival's safety-slowdown stance.
body.zh: 哈萨比斯公开支持Dario Amodei放缓前沿AI发展步伐的呼吁，这是顶级实验室领导人罕见地支持竞争对手的安全减速立场。

title.en: "Direction is correct": Google DeepMind co-founder Demis Hassabis backs Anthropic boss Dario Amodei's calls for AI slowdown
title.zh: "Direction is correct": Google DeepMind co-founder Demis Hassabis backs Anthropic boss Dario Amodei's calls for AI slowdown

body.en: Hassabis publicly backed Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's call to slow the pace of frontier AI development, saying the direction was correct.
body.zh: 哈萨比斯公开表示支持Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei关于放缓前沿AI发展步伐的呼吁，称这一方向是正确的。

title.en: Google DeepMind Pioneer Demis Hassabis Pushes for Independent AI Safety Body
title.zh: Google DeepMind Pioneer Demis Hassabis Pushes for Independent AI Safety Body

body.en: He publicly calls for an independent international AI safety body, one of his clearest policy positions.
body.zh: 他公开呼吁设立独立的国际人工智能安全机构，是他最明确的政策表态之一。

title.en: As 'Demis Hassabis wanted to LEAVE Google alongside Jeff Dean' speculations go viral; Hassabis shares his message to employees in a long LinkedIn post
title.zh: As 'Demis Hassabis wanted to LEAVE Google alongside Jeff Dean' speculations go viral; Hassabis shares his message to employees in a long LinkedIn post

body.en: Addressed viral speculation that he wanted to leave Google alongside Jeff Dean, sharing a message to employees on LinkedIn.
body.zh: 针对有关他曾想与Jeff Dean一同离开谷歌的网络传言，他在LinkedIn上发布长文回应员工。

title.en: Google DeepMind enters a new era as co-founder Demis Hassabis shifts AI role
title.zh: Google DeepMind enters a new era as co-founder Demis Hassabis shifts AI role

body.en: He steps back from running Google DeepMind day to day, moving to chair and Alphabet chief scientist while DeepMind is reorganised.
body.zh: 他不再直接负责 Google DeepMind 的日常运营，转任董事长与 Alphabet 首席科学家，DeepMind 同时进行重组。

title.en: Nobel laureate Demis Hassabis named Alphabet chief scientist
title.zh: Nobel laureate Demis Hassabis named Alphabet chief scientist

body.en: Nobel laureate Demis Hassabis was named Alphabet's chief scientist.
body.zh: 诺贝尔奖得主 Demis Hassabis 被任命为 Alphabet 首席科学家。

title.en: Demis Hassabis quit managing DeepMind to focus on AGI — he says it’s almost here
title.zh: Demis Hassabis quit managing DeepMind to focus on AGI — he says it’s almost here

body.en: Hassabis said he has stepped back from day-to-day management of DeepMind to focus on the pursuit of AGI, which he believes is close.
body.zh: 哈萨比斯表示他已不再负责DeepMind的日常管理,转而专注于他认为已近在咫尺的通用人工智能(AGI)研究。

title.en: Inside Google DeepMind's Reshuffle After CEO Demis Hassabis Steps Aside
title.zh: Inside Google DeepMind's Reshuffle After CEO Demis Hassabis Steps Aside

body.en: Google DeepMind reorganized its leadership after Demis Hassabis stepped aside as CEO, a transition that matches his move to the Chair role.
body.zh: 在戴密斯·哈萨比斯卸任CEO后，谷歌DeepMind对领导层进行了重组，这与他转任董事长一职相吻合。

title.en: Google chief scientist Jeff Dean departs, Demis Hassabis steps down as DeepMind CEO
title.zh: Google chief scientist Jeff Dean departs, Demis Hassabis steps down as DeepMind CEO

body.en: Demis Hassabis stepped down as CEO of Google DeepMind as part of a broader leadership shakeup that also saw Google chief scientist Jeff Dean depart.
body.zh: 作为谷歌高层人事变动的一部分，Demis Hassabis卸任Google DeepMind首席执行官，同期谷歌首席科学家Jeff Dean也已离职。

title.en: Google DeepMind Boss Demis Hassabis Steps Down From CEO Role
title.zh: Google DeepMind Boss Demis Hassabis Steps Down From CEO Role

body.en: Hassabis stepped down as CEO of Google DeepMind, moving into a chief scientist role at Alphabet while remaining DeepMind's chair.
body.zh: 哈萨比斯卸任Google DeepMind首席执行官,转任Alphabet首席科学家,同时继续担任DeepMind董事长。

title.en: Demis Hassabis steps down as DeepMind CEO, plus more Google leadership changes
title.zh: Demis Hassabis steps down as DeepMind CEO, plus more Google leadership changes

body.en: Hassabis stepped down as Google DeepMind CEO, moving to Chair of DeepMind and Chief Scientist of Alphabet as part of a broader Google AI leadership reshuffle.
body.zh: 哈萨比斯卸任Google DeepMind CEO一职，转任DeepMind董事长及Alphabet首席科学家，此举是谷歌AI领导层更大规模调整的一部分。

title.en: Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis Is Stepping Down, But Will Remain With The Company
title.zh: Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis Is Stepping Down, But Will Remain With The Company

body.en: Hassabis is stepping down as Google DeepMind CEO while remaining with the company, a major role change as he shifts focus.
body.zh: Hassabis将卸任Google DeepMind首席执行官一职，但仍留在公司，这是他转变工作重心过程中的一次重大职务变动。

title.en: Google AI CEO Demis Hassabis on why DeepMind sold to Google: The Atari work alerted the Silicon Valley, a
title.zh: Google AI CEO Demis Hassabis on why DeepMind sold to Google: The Atari work alerted the Silicon Valley, a

body.en: Hassabis recounted that DeepMind's Atari-playing work is what first caught Silicon Valley's attention and led to Google's acquisition.
body.zh: Hassabis回顾称，正是DeepMind在Atari游戏上的研究工作率先引起了硅谷的关注，并促成了谷歌的收购。

title.en: Demis Hassabis says AGI could arrive by 2029
title.zh: Demis Hassabis says AGI could arrive by 2029

body.en: Hassabis publicly predicted AGI could arrive by 2029, a notable timeline stance from Google DeepMind's chief.
body.zh: 哈萨比斯公开预测通用人工智能（AGI）最快可能在2029年到来，这是这位DeepMind掌门人对时间线的一次重要表态。
